app.name: Samaj Setu
app.tagline: Khatri Kshatriya Samaj — Surti · Khambhati · Ahmedabadi · Indori
app.demoBody: This is a preview for samaj feedback. The profiles shown are samples, nothing you enter is saved, and phone login isn't switched on yet.

home.title: For our sons and daughters
home.subtitle: Every biodata in one place. Nobody sees a phone number or photo without your permission.
home.addBiodataHint: Paste it from WhatsApp — takes about a minute
home.browseProfilesHint: Search by age, education and city
home.step1Body: Copy it from WhatsApp and paste. Every field fills in automatically.
home.step2Body: Mosal, Bhagat/Jagat and kundali are filtered automatically.
home.step3Body: Phone numbers appear only after both families agree.
home.privacyBody: Unlike the group — here nobody can see your daughter's photo or number until you say yes. You can also see exactly who viewed the profile.
home.j1Body: A mobile number and an OTP — that's all.
home.j2Body: Fill in the form, or paste it from WhatsApp.
home.j3Body: Find the right match and send an interest.
home.heroAccent: The right family, the right match
home.storyBody1: This is only for families of the samaj. Nobody outside can join, and a moderator reviews every biodata before it goes live.
home.storyBody2: Mosal, Bhagat/Jagat and the kundali are filtered automatically — so a family that can't work is never shown to you in the first place. It saves both sides the phone call.

browse.title: Browse profiles
browse.noResultsHint: Try loosening a filter or two.

profile.photoLocked: Permission needed to view the photo

import.title: Add a biodata
import.pasteHelp: In WhatsApp: press and hold the biodata → Copy → paste it here. Gujarati or English both work.
import.pastePlaceholder:
Name: ...
Father's name: ...
Date of birth: ...
import.reviewHelp: Check anything highlighted in yellow — we weren't sure about those.
import.submittedBody: A samaj moderator will review it, then the profile goes live for everyone. This usually takes about a day.
import.parseError: We couldn't read that. Try again, or fill it in yourself.

interests.title: Interests
interests.emptyHint: Browse profiles and send an interest — they'll show up here.
interests.noReceived: Nobody has sent you an interest yet
interests.noSent: You haven't sent any interests yet

mine.title: My profiles
mine.empty: You haven't added a biodata yet

form.chooseTitle: How would you like to fill it in?
form.chooseHelp: Either way — you'll get to check everything at the end.
form.chooseFormHint: One question at a time. Nothing to copy.
form.choosePasteHint: Already have a biodata? The form fills itself in.
form.prefilled: We've filled in what you pasted. Please check it.
form.errorFixBelow: Please check the fields marked below
form.nameHelp: Given name, father's name and surname — as written on the biodata
form.birthTimeHelp: The kundali depends on this — copy it from the janmakshar if you can
form.occupationDetailPlaceholder: e.g. Valuation Officer at ICICI Bank, Vesu branch
form.cityLabel: Which city do you live in now?
form.mosalHelp: Maternal grandfather's full name and surname. A shared mosal rules out a match, so this matters.
form.astroHelp: Leave blank if you don't know — we compute it from the date and time of birth.
form.phoneHelp: Nobody sees this number. It appears only after both families agree.
form.addressHelp: The address is visible only to you.
form.reviewHelp: Tap a step to change anything.
form.consentListing: I consent to this biodata being listed for the samaj.
form.consentCandidate: The person this biodata is about has agreed to this.
form.consentRequired: Please tick both boxes to continue.
form.errNotActive: Your account isn't approved yet. Please contact a samaj admin.
form.errNotAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.
form.errDuplicate: This biodata has already been submitted.
form.errDemo: This is a demo — nothing is saved yet.
form.errUnknown: Couldn't save that. Please try again.
form.qRelation: Who are you filling this in for?
form.qRelationHelp: Tell us your relationship. We'll ask whose biodata it is next.
form.qGenderHelp: For a son or for a daughter — pick one.
form.qNameHelp: Write it in Gujarati. The English name is optional.
form.qDob: What is the date of birth?
form.qDobHelp: Age is calculated from this date automatically.
form.qBirthHelp: Needed for the kundali. If you don't know the exact time, tick the box below rather than guessing.
form.qBodyHelp: Height is the most-used filter, which is why it's required.
form.qSubCommunityHelp: If you're not sure, ask an elder at home.
form.qSectHelp: Many families treat this as a hard requirement, so it matters that it's right.
form.qEducationHelp: Naming the degree tells families far more than the level alone.
form.qOccupationHelp: A line of detail says much more than just “Job”.
form.qPlace: Which city do you live in?
form.qFamilyExtra: A little more about the family
form.qFamilyExtraHelp: All optional. Skip ahead if you'd rather not fill these in.
form.qContactHelp: The number is only revealed once another family sends interest and you accept it.
